controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE : rachat de Dominion Energy annonce le 15 mai 2026, parite 0,8138 action NEE + quote-part de 360 M$ en cash ; 2,25 Mds $ de credits clients en Virginie et Carolines ; cloture visee au second semestre 2027 ; accords requis FERC, NRC et commissions de trois Etats.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 Note 5 : "On May 15, 2026, NEE and Dominion Energy entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger... (i) a pro rata share of an aggregate amount equal to $360 million in cash, without interest, and (ii) 0.8138 shares of NEE common stock. In addition, NEE and Dominion Energy have proposed $2.25 billion in bill credits for Dominion Energy's utility customers in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina spread over two years post-close... working to complete the transaction in the second half of 2027... including approvals by the FERC, the NRC, and the utility commissions in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina as well as clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act"

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE/CONTRACTUEL : indemnite de rupture de 4,8 Mds $ ou 6,5 Mds $ a la charge de NextEra, contre environ 2,2 Mds $ dans l'autre sens.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 Note 5 : "NEE would be required to pay to Dominion Energy a termination fee of $4.8 billion or $6.5 billion, depending on the circumstances of the termination, while under other circumstances, Dominion Energy would be required to pay NEE a termination fee of approximately $2.2 billion."

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE : loi OBBBA du 4 juillet 2025 ; 100% du PTC ou 30% de l'ITC seulement si construction commencee avant le 5 juillet 2026 ou mise en service avant le 31 decembre 2027 ; regles d'origine des composants pour tout projet demarre apres le 31 decembre 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Wind and solar generation facilities are eligible for 100% PTC or 30% ITC if such facilities begin construction before July 5, 2026 or are placed in service by December 31, 2027." ; "All facilities and projects discussed above that begin construction after December 31, 2025 must satisfy the prohibited foreign entity material assistance requirements under the OBBBA in order to be eligible for tax credits."

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE : accord tarifaire FPL de janvier 2026 a decembre 2029, ROE reglementaire autorise de 10,95%, reserve de lissage (RSM) d'environ 1,5 Md $ apres impot, 150 M$ deja utilises au S1 2026 et 1,335 Md $ restant au 30 juin 2026 ; revision possible des tarifs en cas de changement permanent d'impot.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In January 2026, the FPSC issued a final order approving a stipulation and settlement agreement between FPL and several intervenors in FPL's base rate proceeding (2025 rate agreement)... effective in January 2026 and continues through at least December 2029" ; "FPL's authorized regulatory ROE is 10.95%, with a range of 9.95% to 11.95%" ; "authorized to implement a rate stabilization mechanism (RSM)... up to approximately $1.5 billion, after tax" ; 10-Q : "approximately $150 million of ITC amortization, utilized as part of the RSM" et "approximately $1.335 billion, after tax, of total RSM reserve remains available"
controles.correction_proposee: Precision de forme : l'accord est un reglement negocie entre FPL et des intervenants, approuve par ordonnance finale du FPSC en janvier 2026, plutot qu'un accord signe avec le regulateur.

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Cash flows from operating activities $7,276" et "Capital expenditures, independent power and other investments and nuclear fuel purchases (19,389)" : 19 389 - 7 276 = 12 113 M$. Aucun montant de 11,8 Mds $ n'apparait ; le champ "chiffre" du meme bloc dit d'ailleurs -12 113 M$ et le hook dit 12,1 Mds $, et le calcul de hausse de 58% par rapport aux 7 668 M$ du S1 2025 n'est exact qu'avec 12 113.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer le titre par "Un deficit de tresorerie de 12,1 Mds $ sur six mois" (coherent avec le hook, le champ chiffre et le 10-Q).
